lead.headline: Rice still hasn't practised and Jacobs is undecided — no claim tonight
lead.deck: The bye holes are filled; two coin flips wait on Friday's practice reports.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Rashee Rice has not practised since early October; ESPN moved him from OUT to QUESTIONABLE today, but the latest report still lists his hamstring and knee as status to be determined. Josh Jacobs is off the Exempt List and Green Bay have not decided whether he plays. Stroud and Gordon are in for the bye players, and the lineup projects 119.9 against Furia Regia's 111.6, 54% on ESPN. The projection would take Rice over Pickens by 0.2 and Jacobs over Gordon by 0.9 — both coin flips, both waiting for practice. Nothing on the wire is worth priority that never resets, so there is no claim before 01:00.
